# Results (generated by `python hawkdove.py analyze`)

Sample: 2004-09-20 to 2026-10-30; 2028 speeches; 15298 policy sentences.
Sentence mix: {'neutral': 0.544, 'dovish': 0.368, 'hawkish': 0.087}

## 1. Does speech tone anticipate rate changes?
OLS, dependent variable = change in deposit facility rate over the next 3 months (pp), monthly, HAC(3) s.e., n = 251.
```
            Coef.  Std.Err.       z   P>|z|  [0.025  0.975]
const     -0.1004    0.0642 -1.5653  0.1175 -0.2262  0.0253
index     -0.0448    0.1104 -0.4057  0.6849 -0.2611  0.1716
hicp_yoy   0.0438    0.0253  1.7303  0.0836 -0.0058  0.0935
dfr_past3  0.4969    0.0968  5.1331  0.0000  0.3072  0.6866
```
R² = 0.413. Correlation of monthly index with HICP inflation: 0.43.

## 2. Do yields react on speech days?
OLS, dependent variable = same-day change in AAA euro yield (bp), regressor = standardised speech score, HAC(5) s.e.; days in the week before a deposit-rate change excluded (decision announcements); n = 1475 speech days.
| Yield | Coef. per 1 s.d. of tone (bp) | t-stat | p-value | R² |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| d2y | 0.078 | 0.81 | 0.420 | 0.0005 |
| d10y | 0.090 | 0.89 | 0.373 | 0.0005 |
